what: two plain cave mushrooms growing joined at the foot, a big one and a small one leaning against it, touching: each has a wide, low, flat cap like a field mushroom, dull earthy grey-brown and matt, with a paler rim, and under the cap dark brown gills; the stems are short, thick and pale tan. They are plain, dry, ordinary eating mushrooms with no glow and no spots.
colours: Dull earthy grey-brown caps with paler tan rims, dark brown gills, pale tan stems.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: two joined mushrooms, one big, one small
wide flat dull brown caps
thick pale stems

what: one clump of swamp moss pulled up whole: a single soft rounded cushion of thick deep emerald-green moss, wider than it is tall, its top a mass of tiny soft tufts, and hanging from its underside a short ragged beard of dark brown roots and peat. It is one lump, like a small green loaf.
colours: Deep emerald-green moss, brighter green on the lit tufts, a dark brown rooty underside.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: one rounded cushion of green moss
dark brown ragged roots underneath

what: one rough broken chunk of rock salt as big as a fist, wider than it is tall: an uneven craggy lump of salt crystal with a jagged outline, glassy and half see-through like cloudy ice. Its surface is a jumble of square-edged crystal faces of different sizes set at different angles, a few big ones and many small ones, with broken corners and one deep crack, and its lower part is crusted with fine white grains. No two sides of it are alike.
colours: White and pale grey cloudy crystal, glassy, with darker grey depths in the cracks, bright white glints on the crystal edges and a faint pale warm tint at the base.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: one rough uneven chunk of white crystal
square-edged crystal faces of different sizes at different angles
wider than tall, jagged outline

what: a handful of altar incense, raw frankincense: five rough lumps of hardened tree resin heaped together and touching, three below and two on top, each lump a quarter of the heap wide. The lumps are knobbly and uneven, no two alike, like drops of sap that have set hard: glassy, half see-through, deep honey-amber, with a bright yellow glow where the light passes through their edges and small dull dusty patches on their sides. One short thick curl of pale grey smoke rises from the topmost lump, joined to it, no taller than the lump itself.
colours: Deep honey-amber glassy resin, bright yellow where the light shines through, dark brown-amber in the gaps, a few dull grey-tan dusty patches; one small pale grey curl of smoke.
pose: Lying in one small heap, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: small heap of rough amber resin lumps
glassy, half see-through amber
one small curl of smoke joined to the top

what: a pilgrim's flask of holy water: one small squat bottle of plain pale fired clay, unglazed and matt, with a round fat belly flattened at the front, a short narrow neck, and a thick brown cork stopper pushed into the mouth. On the flat front of the belly is one big plain cross, an upright bar and a shorter crossbar, inlaid in solid dark blue, as tall as the belly. The clay is thick and solid; nothing can be seen through it. A short loop of dark cord is tied round the neck.
colours: Pale cream-grey clay with warm grey shading; one bold dark blue cross on the front; a brown cork; a dark brown cord.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above, the cross facing the viewer.
must_show: one small squat clay bottle with a cork
one bold dark cross on its front
pale matt clay, not glass

what: one single shard of clear crystal broken from a cave wall: one thick six-sided column of crystal, three times as long as it is thick, with flat glassy faces and sharp straight edges, cut to a blunt six-sided point at one end and snapped off rough and jagged at the other, with one small second crystal budding from its side near the broken end. It is solid and thick; the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, white on the lit faces and deeper blue on the shaded faces.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the broken end at the bottom left, the point at the top right.
must_show: one thick six-sided crystal with a point
pale icy blue with flat faces
broken rough at the other end

what: one shaving of deep-iron, a curl of metal pared off a block the way a plane pares a curl off wood: a single broad flat ribbon of dark iron, as wide as two fingers and thick as a coin, curled round on itself into a loose open spiral of two turns, like a wood shaving, its outer end sticking out straight. The broad face of the ribbon is scored with fine lines along it.
colours: Dark charcoal-grey iron, nearly black inside the curl, with broad pale steel-grey highlights along the lit edge and face.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from the front and a little from above, so the open spiral shows.
must_show: one broad flat ribbon of dark metal curled in a spiral
dark iron with a pale lit edge

what: one short frond of kelp from the lightless deep sea: a thick rubbery stalk at the bottom, and growing from it three broad flat leathery blades with wavy crinkled edges, the middle one longest, spreading a little like three fingers; where each blade joins the stalk sits one round hollow float as big as a grape. The kelp is very dark, almost black, and along the middle of each blade runs a row of four big round spots that glow pale aqua, as much green as blue.
colours: Very dark blue-black green, like a wet slate, with a dull dark teal sheen on the ridges; pale glowing aqua spots; the three floats dull dark amber-brown.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the cut stalk at the bottom left, the tips of the three blades at the top right.
must_show: one dark frond with three broad wavy blades
rows of pale glowing spots
nearly black
